description: COTRN00C LISTS transactions from the TRANSACT file, although rule R1 requires the migrated class to be called TransactionMenuController: the name comes from the prompt and the behaviour from app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl, and a mandated name never authorises a change to what the source does. This case pins the SECOND of the two page-number rewind arms in PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD - :366 MOVE 1 TO CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM, which FORCES the page number to one - as distinct from :364 SUBTRACT 1 FROM CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM, which decrements it. Entry is in RE-ENTRY state: CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 1, so 'IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER' at :112 is FALSE, :118 performs RECEIVE-TRNLST-SCREEN, and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :119 reaches WHEN DFHPF7 at :125 - the THIRD of its five arms, after DFHENTER at :120 and DFHPF3 at :122 have each been evaluated and each been false - which performs PROCESS-PF7-KEY at :126. Because PF7 is not ENTER, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is never performed and the ten-way selection EVALUATE TRUE at :148-182 is not reached at all on this path; that ordered first-match-wins scan is the subject of case14, case15 and case20, and its absence here is why this case declares no received map fields. PROCESS-PF7-KEY finds CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST non-blank at :236, so :239 moves it into TRAN-ID as the browse anchor, :242 SETs NEXT-PAGE-YES - which is why the flag comes back 'Y' - :243 repositions the cursor, and :245 finds the page number above one so :246 performs PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD rather than the 'You are already at the top of the page...' arm at :248-249. Eleven records are on file and the anchor is record eleven of page two: :335 STARTBRs, the EIBAID test at :339 is true for PF7 so the anchor READPREV at :340 consumes record eleven, :343-347 clears all ten rows, :349 primes WS-IDX at TEN, and the loop at :351-357 reads records ten down to one into screen rows ten down to one - so WS-IDX reaches ZERO and the loop ends on its OWN bound rather than on end-of-file, which leaves TRANSACT-NOT-EOF true at :359. The extra look-ahead READPREV at :360 therefore runs off the FRONT of the file and reports ENDFILE, taking READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE's :673-679 arm: it SETs TRANSACT-EOF, moves 'You have reached the top of the page...' - a third distinct top-of-page literal, separate from the 'You are already at the top of the page...' of :248-249 - repositions the cursor at :678 and SENDs at :679, which is the FIRST of the two sends. The NEXT-PAGE-YES test at :361 then passes, but the condition at :362-363 is false on its FIRST conjunct rather than on the page-number one, because TRANSACT-EOF was set a moment earlier - so control reaches :366 and the page number is FORCED to one instead of being decremented to one. The two arms are indistinguishable here by VALUE and entirely distinct by PATH, which is why the ENDFILE message is pinned alongside the page number: it is the evidence that :366 and not :364 was taken. :371 ENDBRs, :373 moves the page number into PAGENUMI and :374 SENDs again - the SECOND send - and control returns to MAIN-PARA, which ends the pseudo-conversation at :138-141 with EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA). No XCTL is executed, so the termination is RETURN_TRANSID and no next program is named; the mapset and map the response carries are the COTRN00 and COTRN0A of the two sends at :534-540. The ten painted rows leave the two browse anchors behind them: :393 sets CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST from the record in row one and :439 sets CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST from the record in row ten, so a page showing records one to ten reports exactly those two identifiers. The cursor is TRNIDINL because :105 sets it in MAIN-PARA before any branch is taken, reinforced at :243 and again at :678. Under rule R6 the whole conversation state travels in the payload and nothing is held server-side: the shared 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and the 58-byte CDEMO-CT00-INFO extension COTRN00C appends at :62-70 both come back in the response, which is what makes the page number, the next-page flag and the two anchors comparable at all (gate G37). Each of the eleven seeded rows is the 350 bytes CVTRA05Y declares, ending in the FILLER X(20) span at offsets 330 to 349 emitted as spaces - a codec that dropped the FILLER would be twenty bytes short and every offset after it would shift (gate G21) - and TRAN-AMT is the eleven-byte S9(09)V99 span at offset 132 carrying its sign as a zoned overpunch in its trailing byte at scale two (gate G23). Both timestamps are pinned rather than read from a clock, as is the 2022-07-19T23:12:34 the :569 FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE observes for the CURDATEO and CURTIMEO of both sends (practice B7). Nothing here writes: the screen browses TRANSACT through STARTBR, READPREV and ENDBR only, and the program has no keyed READ and no WRITE anywhere, so both record expectations are empty and that emptiness is a positive assertion that a paging path mutates nothing. COTRN00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY nor CSMSG02Y and never writes an attribute byte, so no highlight is expected on any field. The forced-to-one page number is an inherited oddity of the program rather than a translation artefact and is preserved rather than tidied (practice B5). Two derived variants in COTRN00CParityTest re-anchor THIS case's invocation over other seeds - one where the loop runs out of records before it runs out of rows, one where it runs out of rows before records - and both assert that the case they derive from already carries DFHPF7, so the AID declared here must not be changed; the eleven-row seed is load-bearing for the same reason, since leaving exactly ten records below the anchor is what makes :366 reachable at all. Statically derived by reading app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl paragraph by paragraph and cross-checking app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy for the 350-byte record, app/cpy-bms/COTRN00.CPY for the xxxI widths, app/bms/COTRN00.bms for the DFHMDF lengths and app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the 160-byte commarea - never captured from a running COBOL program, which is empirically impossible in this environment (practice B12, risk R-A).
